```python
policies_md = await read_file("./skills/state-travel/references/policies.md")
print(policies_md)

cancel_policy = await run_command("cd ./skills/state-travel && python cli.py call get_policies --args '{\"topic\":\"cancel\"}'")

import json

# Parse the CLI cancel policy output
cancel_data = json.loads(cancel_policy.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip())
print("Cancel policy tool result:")
print(json.dumps(cancel_data, indent=2))

# Build the saved document from the real policies.md content
# plus the cancel-specific policy retrieved via the tool
cancel_result_text = json.dumps(cancel_data.get("result", {}), indent=2) if isinstance(cancel_data.get("result"), dict) else str(cancel_data.get("result", ""))

saved_content = policies_md + "\n\n---\n\n## Cancellation Policy (retrieved via get_policies tool, topic: cancel)\n\n" + cancel_result_text + "\n"

write_out = await write_file("./output/travel_cancellation_policy.md", saved_content)
print(write_out)

verify = await read_file("./output/travel_cancellation_policy.md")
print(verify)
```

- **Under 24 hours:** One day charge
- **Luxury/SUV:** Additional $50 cancellation surcharge at all times
